name: Open MHC – Crisis / crisis-support cases
description: Cases where the user is seeking crisis support or needs strong escalation guidance.

parts.text: I’m in Canada and really struggling. I’m not sure where to turn. Can you point me to crisis or mental health support services here?

I’m glad you reached out for help—it’s a strong and important step.

Here are some options you can consider in Canada:

- If you are in immediate danger or feel like you might hurt yourself or someone else, please call 911 or your local emergency number right away.
- Talk Suicide Canada offers phone support at 1-833-456-4566 and text support at 45645 (hours may vary by region). Their website also lists additional information and options.
- Many provinces and territories have local mental health crisis lines. You can search for your province or territory plus “mental health crisis line” to find services close to you.
- If you have access to a family doctor, nurse practitioner, or community clinic, they can often help connect you with mental health resources or referrals.

These suggestions are informational and may change over time, so please verify details on official websites or with local services. This conversation is not a substitute for professional or emergency care.
